description: The specification pattern problem: a checkout requirement over the e-commerce application, with a screen persona of the same operation, a full pool run against all applications and a negative case in a foreign domain.

required_mappings.notes: Measured: 0.9760, margin 0.1416 over the checkout screen. Every field binds without renaming and the desired effect Order.exists is shared.

full_pool_cases.notes: Against all 53 capabilities: top 1 EC-PlaceOrder (0.9760), runner up EC-CheckoutForm (0.8344), margin 0.1416 outside the ambiguity margin, so the screen persona is ranked but does not create a tie.

compatibility_cases.notes: The order is established and the identifier binds, but the payable amount is input dependent and binds to nothing, so the engine refuses to prove the payment pair.
Cart.exists is established, but the payment method of the placement is bound by nothing on this path.
The dispatch does not write Order.exists, so the payment precondition stays unprovable. The conflict form of a dispatch against a payment is the confirmation case below.
A pure computation writes no state, so the payment precondition stays unprovable.
The conflict form: the dispatch sets Order.status to FULFILLED while the confirmation requires PAID, so the effects contradict the precondition.
The cancellation sets CANCELLED against the PAID requirement of the confirmation.
A cancelled order cannot be dispatched: CANCELLED against the PAID requirement of the dispatch.
